project_title: THE DEVIL ALL THE TIME REVIEW
timeline_mode_reason: The review opens on the prayer log at 22:24 and then rewinds to the war, and it groups the film's cross-cut threads by character. Neither is chronological in source time.

reference_structure.note: Structure only. That review reveals the ending; this map stops before the shooting.
carried_over: one character group at a time instead of the film's cross-cutting
single short beats for connective information
the closing confrontations take the largest share
the film's own dialogue left running at the confrontations
an unbroken closing block: theme, then protagonist read, then the cast hook
the cast hook is promised in the title and paid off only at the very end
deliberately_not_carried: the outcome. The reference names who dies and who walks away; this map cuts on the raised guns at 126:10, the last line before the shooting.

sections.audience_question: Why is this man kneeling at a cross in the woods?
sections.exit_answer: Because he came back from a war carrying something he has no other way to set down

events.summary: Willard kneels at a cross he built in the woods, his son beside him
events.visible_action: A father and son on their knees at a log cross, the wood dark with blood
events.emotional_stake: The ritual arrives with no explanation, which is exactly why it holds
events.question_opened: What is this prayer trying to hold back?

sections.audience_question: Where did Willard get this faith?
sections.exit_answer: From a man nailed to a cross in the Pacific he could not save and had to finish
sections.next_question: What holds the family he builds together?

events.summary: In the Pacific, Willard finds a US soldier nailed up and still alive
events.visible_action: A man lashed to a cross, maggots, Willard raising his sidearm
events.emotional_stake: Everything he later does with God starts here
events.question_opened: What does that leave in him?

events.summary: On the way home he sees Charlotte in a diner and says nothing
events.visible_action: A diner counter, a waitress, a man walking out without a word
events.emotional_stake: His silence is what lets his mother start arranging his life
events.question_opened: Will he come back for her?

events.summary: His mother Emma lines him up with Helen from her church
events.visible_action: A conversation outside the church, mother and son
events.emotional_stake: Two marriages get decided in one conversation
events.question_opened: Which woman does he choose?

sections.audience_question: What became of the other couple from that same church?
sections.exit_answer: Roy proved his faith with a jar of spiders, and Helen read it as a sign and took him
sections.next_question: How far will that kind of faith go?

events.summary: Roy the preacher pours a jar of spiders over his own head to prove his faith
events.visible_action: A pulpit, a jar of spiders, a congregation coming apart
events.emotional_stake: Summarising this would kill it, so the scene has to play
events.question_opened: What kind of person falls for this man?

events.summary: Helen takes it as a sign and chooses him
events.visible_action: Helen's face after the service, moving toward him
events.emotional_stake: This is the choice the rest of her life answers for
events.question_opened: How does this marriage end?

sections.audience_question: What does the father teach the son?
sections.exit_answer: That the world is full of no-good sons of bitches and the only thing you choose is your moment
sections.next_question: When does that lesson get used?

events.summary: Arvin gets worked over by older boys on the school bus
events.visible_action: A bus seat, a swollen eye, a boy keeping his head down
events.emotional_stake: He is carrying it alone, and his father notices
events.question_opened: How does his father step in?

events.summary: Willard teaches Arvin to wait for the right moment and then settle it
events.visible_action: A car pulled over, two men on the ground, a boy watching
events.emotional_stake: Every choice Arvin makes later traces back to this lesson
events.question_opened: When does Arvin use it?

events.summary: Charlotte collapses at home and the diagnosis comes back cancer
events.visible_action: A woman on the kitchen floor, her husband running
events.emotional_stake: This is where the praying stops working
events.question_opened: How far will Willard go to fix it?

events.summary: Willard sacrifices Arvin's dog at the prayer log
events.visible_action: The cross, a man carrying a dog up the hill, his son's face
events.emotional_stake: The moment Arvin stops believing anything his father believes
events.question_opened: What is left for the boy?

sections.audience_question: Where does Roy's faith finally stop?
sections.exit_answer: At a body he cannot pray back up, and a car he gets into with two strangers
sections.next_question: Where does their child end up?

events.summary: Roy kills Helen in the woods, then tries to raise her from the dead
events.visible_action: Woods, a screwdriver, a body, two men driving away
events.emotional_stake: Faith turns into murder in about a minute
events.question_opened: How far does he get?

events.summary: Roy thumbs a ride and gets into Carl and Sandy's car
events.visible_action: A highway, a man getting in, a camera on the seat
events.emotional_stake: We can see what he is getting into and he cannot
events.question_opened: Why does this couple pick people up?

sections.audience_question: How do the two orphaned kids grow up?
sections.exit_answer: In one house under one grandmother, with Arvin standing between Lenora and everyone else
sections.next_question: Who walks into their lives next?

events.summary: A grown Arvin settles it for Lenora when boys go after her
events.visible_action: Behind the school, three boys down, Arvin walking her home
events.emotional_stake: His father's rule is running him now
events.question_opened: What are these two to each other?

events.summary: Uncle Earskell hands Arvin his father's pistol for his birthday
events.visible_action: A kitchen table, an old Luger, a boy taking it
events.emotional_stake: Once the gun is on screen the only question is when
events.question_opened: Who does that gun end up pointed at?

sections.audience_question: What does the new preacher bring to this town?
sections.exit_answer: A voice the congregation loves, and a habit of getting girls alone in his car

events.summary: Preston Teagardin takes over the pulpit
events.visible_action: A new preacher at the church, a grandmother cooking to welcome him
events.emotional_stake: One arrival tips the whole town
events.question_opened: What kind of man is he?

events.summary: Teagardin turns a welcome dinner into a sermon aimed at the room
events.visible_action: A preacher standing over a table, chicken livers, faces going stiff
events.emotional_stake: His whole method is in how he talks, so let him talk
events.question_opened: Who does that voice get turned on?

events.summary: Teagardin uses counselling to get Lenora alone
events.visible_action: A parked car, an empty church, a girl and a preacher
events.emotional_stake: He uses her faith as the way in
events.question_opened: What does she think is happening?

sections.audience_question: Who is the law here, and who is hunting?
sections.exit_answer: A sheriff selling the county to keep his job, and a couple who photograph the men they pick up
sections.next_question: When do these roads cross Arvin's?

events.summary: Carl's rule for picking hitchhikers gets spelled out
events.visible_action: A camera, a highway, another man getting in
events.emotional_stake: Now every ride in this film reads as a countdown
events.question_opened: Who is next?

events.summary: Sheriff Bodecker runs the county on bribes and threats
events.visible_action: Campaign signs, a diner booth, an envelope changing hands
events.emotional_stake: The law here is not protection, it is another threat
events.question_opened: If Arvin gets in trouble, who comes for him?

sections.exit_answer: To a rope in the barn, carrying a child she was told to get rid of

events.summary: Lenora tells Teagardin she is pregnant and he turns on her
events.visible_action: A car, a preacher facing away, a girl left in it
events.emotional_stake: He makes it her fault and drives off
events.question_opened: What is left open to her?

events.summary: Lenora hangs herself, and changes her mind a second too late
events.visible_action: A barn, a bucket, a girl who has just realised she was wrong
events.emotional_stake: We are told what she is thinking while it happens
events.question_opened: How does Arvin learn the truth?

events.summary: Arvin hears the church will not bury a suicide
events.visible_action: A kitchen conversation, a boy's face closing
events.emotional_stake: The man who did it is fine, and she is the one shut out
events.question_opened: What does Arvin decide?

sections.audience_question: Who does Arvin use his father's rule on?
sections.exit_answer: The preacher, after being given every chance to say one true thing
sections.next_question: Where does he go after that?

events.summary: Arvin calls Teagardin out by asking for time as a sinner
events.visible_action: An empty church, two men sitting, a pistol
events.emotional_stake: The longest verbal fight in the film, so it plays with nothing over it
events.question_opened: What does the preacher admit?

events.summary: Talking runs out and Arvin fires
events.visible_action: A shot inside a church, a young man leaving fast
events.emotional_stake: The line he cannot walk back
events.question_opened: Who starts hunting him now?

sections.audience_question: Whose car picks up a boy on the run?
sections.exit_answer: The same couple that picked up Roy, and this time the photographer is the one on the ground

events.summary: On the run, Arvin gets into Carl and Sandy's car
events.visible_action: A highway, a boy in the back seat, the car turning off into trees
events.emotional_stake: The rule from earlier means we already know what this ride is
events.question_opened: Who moves first?

events.summary: In the woods it goes wrong for the couple instead
events.visible_action: A clearing, a camera, two guns
events.emotional_stake: The film's two loaded threats finally hit each other
events.question_opened: Whose family does this land on?

events.summary: Bodecker learns the two bodies are his sister and her husband
events.visible_action: A radio call, a sheriff driving out, a scene in the woods
events.emotional_stake: This stops being police work
events.question_opened: Where will he look for Arvin?

sections.audience_question: What is waiting where Arvin goes back to?
sections.exit_answer: The sheriff, in the trees above the prayer log, both men out of cover and both guns up
sections.next_question: Which one of them fires first?

events.summary: Arvin walks back to the empty hill he grew up on
events.visible_action: A collapsed house and barn, a short exchange with a stranger
events.emotional_stake: He has come back to where it started, which is not an accident
events.question_opened: Why here?

events.summary: Arvin finally understands his father had no choice either
events.visible_action: The rotted prayer log, and his father's face in memory
events.emotional_stake: The one moment he forgives the man who ruined him
events.question_opened: Where does that leave him?

events.summary: Bodecker calls his name through the trees
events.visible_action: A sheriff with a gun, timber, a young man not moving
events.emotional_stake: Hunter and hunted are finally in the same clearing
events.question_opened: Does Arvin come out?

events.summary: Both guns up, Arvin offering a photograph as proof and asking him to stand down
events.visible_action: Two men facing each other, two barrels, a snapshot in a pocket
events.emotional_stake: The last second this could end with words is running out
events.question_opened: Who fires first?

sections.audience_question: What was this story actually about?
sections.exit_answer: Everyone in it does the worst thing they do for a reason they believe is good
sections.next_question: Whose reason would you have believed?

events.summary: One line of theme over a boy walking up to an empty house
events.visible_action: A pickup outside the house, and a small figure coming up the road alone
events.emotional_stake: Every choice made for good reasons leaves blood behind it, and that is the film
events.question_opened: Where do choices like that end?

events.summary: The cast promised in the title, finally named
events.visible_action: Bodecker alone in his office, the face the poster sells
events.emotional_stake: Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson, Sebastian Stan and Eliza Scanlen in one small film is the hook
events.question_opened: Why did all of them sign up for this one?
